context: A mid-size fundamental long/short equity fund. ~30 investment staff, a three-person data team that licenses and cleans alt-data panels, and one engineer. Horizon is six to eighteen months. They can run a panel study or a cohort analysis and routinely buy transaction and web data, but they do not have tick data or execution infrastructure and will not build production ML. Output is expected to change position sizing on named companies, and to be defensible to a PM who will ask what would have to be true for it to be wrong.
seed: Do changes in next-two-year revenue and EBITDA CAGR drive earnings-multiple re-ratings among peers within an industry?
